reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every day. The lab report is nice, but it does not fix the pill problem.
objection: Two capsules a day is a dealbreaker for me, and I would not know if I actually feel any difference from magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink powder version with the same tested dose.
